title: Choose the visual world for the jev-trader dashboard
question: The roll assigned Synoptic Chart. One challenger, Gate Board, beat it on both axes. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Synoptic Chart
options.lineage: Met Office surface-pressure charts and the BBC Shipping Forecast
options.thesis: Read the market's news the way a weather service reads pressure: fronts, sea areas, and a forecast in fixed cadence.
options.viewport: Navy rail; giant equity figure with sparkline; per-asset 'sea areas' each with a shipping-cadence forecast line and a news-score chart where threshold crossings are drawn as warm and cold fronts; pipeline station reports on the right.
options.risk: Warm-front vermilion for 'positive' breaks traders' green-up habit, and the Shipping Forecast is a British reference that may not land.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale contrast alone: equity is the one giant figure, everything else small, no tile boxes.
One grotesque family carries display, labels and figures, with tabular numerals throughout.
Selecting an asset or headline dims everything outside its decision chain.
The event log's head names the first and last timestamps in view as you scroll.

options.label: Wire Desk
options.lineage: AP and Reuters wire copy, teleprinter slips, the slot editor's spike
options.thesis: Every headline arrives as wire copy, takes Jev's stamp, and is either spiked or run as a trade.
options.viewport: Green desk rail; the wire in the centre as slips carrying slug, source and Jev's stamp (RUN/SPIKE, asset, sentiment); the run list of positions and fills on the right, each linked to the slips that caused it.
options.risk: The most literal reading of 'news-driven', where many runs land, and wire type flirts with a terminal costume.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and segmented boarding passes
options.thesis: The bot as a departures hall: decisions rerank in place, and anything that changed stays lit until you've seen it.
options.viewport: Three asset passes across the top (position, target, news, momentum, gate); below, a board of pipeline stages and events by time, with changed rows held amber until acknowledged.
options.case: Beats the roll on both axes: everyone reads a departures board, and lit-until-seen is exactly what a tab left open all day needs.
options.risk: Amber for 'changed' competes with amber for 'degraded' unless the state colours are separated carefully.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory Records sleeves and FAC catalog numbering
options.thesis: Each asset's news history as a stacked pulse of white lines on matte black; every trade gets a catalog number.
options.viewport: A black field with one pulse plot per asset over the last 48h of news impulses; trades as TRD-0042 entries; hovering a colour strip decodes it.
options.case: Strong identification for this audience, but coded labels slow a glance: holds audience, loses clarity.
options.risk: The near-black field drifts toward the neon-terminal rut, and coded names hurt monitoring.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: News score drives a font's weight axis across the screen.
options.viewport: One giant numeral morphing with score.
options.case: Loses both axes: expressive, but neither traders nor monitoring read weight as data.

options.label: Annual Plates
options.thesis: Each asset as a registered plate on near-white stock.
options.case: Loses both axes: a design-world reference that slows reading.
options.kept: One typeface carries display and caption alike.

options.label: Title Wall
options.thesis: Headlines as poster tiles in horizontal rows.
options.viewport: Rows of headline tiles per asset.
options.case: Loses both axes: browsing posture, not watching posture.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: The event log set as dictionary entries with guide words.
options.viewport: Columns of entries, charts as plates.
options.case: Loses both axes: bookish and slow for a live monitor.
options.kept: Guide words naming the span in view.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark trading dashboard, executed impeccably: KPI row, equity chart, positions table, logs.
canonCard.viewport: KPI tiles across the top, equity chart, positions table and log stream below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every bot dashboard by design.
